title: Dashboard agent controls reflect implemented runtime

assertions.evidence: Web and Landing dashboards no longer render Start/Stop Agent controls without server implementations.
Web and Landing hooks no longer emit dashboard:agent-start, dashboard:agent-stop, or dashboard:agent-restart.
Web no longer renders the empty no-op realtime toggle.
Web/Landing production builds, typechecks and lint; Web diagnostics 19/19; Browser build/lint and focused tests 16/16; PHDK coherence 63/63.

limitations: This source acceptance does not implement or claim remote agent start/stop behavior.
No packaged Electron run, live customer runtime, or device/audio acceptance was performed; Railway deployment status is tracked separately in delivery evidence.
